surveys.title: Field agents' surveys
surveys.hint: What each agent actually captured in the field, drafts included.
surveys.openStatus: View the surveys with this status
surveys.draftNote: Draft: survey not submitted — still being captured, or sent back for correction by a supervisor. No decision can be made before submission.
surveys.temporaryNote: Provisionally validated: the parcel is deliverable but awaits a re-check. Freeze the validation or reject the survey. If the server refuses the decision — it may only accept submitted surveys — the refusal is shown at the top of the list.
surveys.definitiveNote: Definitively validated: the address code is frozen and the parcel leaves the scope of later campaigns. No further decision is possible on this survey.
surveys.rejectedNote: Rejected: terminal state, the captured data is not reused. The agent must produce a new survey — the parcel returns to the campaign scope.
surveys.emptyNone: No survey on this campaign yet.
surveys.emptyFilteredOne: No "{{status}}" survey — 1 survey under the other tabs.

surveys.emptyMismatchOne: Progress reports 1 survey, but the API returns none for this campaign.
